name: pyATS Docker
description: Official Cisco pyATS test automation framework Docker image. Includes pyATS/Genie libraries for network device testing including NETCONF, RESTCONF, CLI, and gNMI interfaces.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker image on Docker Hub (ciscotestautomation/pyats). Supports pip requirements mounting for custom dependencies. Built-in examples at /pyats workspace.

eval_notes: Cisco's production-grade network test automation framework. Supports multi-vendor NETCONF testing with Genie parsers. XPRESSO dashboard available for test visualization. Industry-standard for Cisco network testing.
